errors.quote: Let $p$ be the precision in bits, $2\le s<t<2^p$ coprime lengths, $\alpha<\sqrt p$ an integer width
errors.problem: The hypotheses p>100 and alpha>=2 are dropped. The paper requires p>100 and 2<=alpha<sqrt p, and the page's later 'errors below $16p<p^2$' needs p>16, which the page's hypotheses do not guarantee.

The unit of error is never given. In the paper, error E means 2^p||L~u-Lu||<E, i.e. it is measured in units of 2^{-p}. Read literally as absolute errors of contractions, these values (and 'error below dp^2') are meaningless.

errors.quote: adjacent interchanges of $\ell$- or $(\ell-1)$-bit address fields, each $O(Tp(1+\ell^\tau))$ by [fast address-chunk interchange](address-chunk-interchange.md)
errors.problem: The chunk-interchange lemma (lem:chunk-swap) exchanges equal-width fields only. For an l-bit/(l-1)-bit pair the paper splits off the leading bit of the longer field, swaps the equal-width pieces, and moves the bit with the fixed-digit movement primitive (lem:elementary-streams).

errors.quote: Since $t_i\ge r/2$, at most $2dT/r$ lines occur, so polynomial setup per line is $o(Tp)$.
errors.problem: The claim is stated unconditionally. The paper's conclusion holds only when r grows faster than every polynomial in p and d is polynomially bounded in p (the ratio O(dp^{c-1}/r) must tend to zero).
